papers.title: ATTUNE: Agentic Throughput Tuning for LLM Training
papers.abstract: The throughput of an LLM training job depends on its recipe: how the model is split across GPUs, how memory is traded for compute, and which kernels and communication overlaps it uses. The best recipe changes with every model, accelerator and framework version. Automated tuners search a fixed space of knobs and check only that a job runs, so they miss levers outside that space and can ship a configuration that silently changes training. ATTUNE is a coding agent that tunes any working recipe unattended within a GPU-hour budget. Guided by a skill of search rules, scripts and lessons from past tuning campaigns, it diagnoses each run and changes one lever at a time. A correctness gate outside the agent refuses any argument known to change the training objective. ATTUNE tunes Amazon's production post-training recipes on H100, H200 and B200 clusters, raising throughput by 1.7x on average. It beats the published throughput of four of NVIDIA's own benchmark recipes on NVIDIA's AutoModel framework by 6-17%. On models held out from its development, it improves the strongest public recipes most where they were written for another setting, by up to 2.6x on MiniMax-M2, and least where the vendor tuned them for the same hardware. Given the same GPU-hour budget, it outperforms existing automated tuners, including Bayesian optimization, random search and OptiCo, a recent LLM-agent tuner. Its gain on GLM-4.5 is more than four times the best alternative's. The same coding agent without ATTUNE's skill gains less and fails half its launches. We release ATTUNE at https://github.com/amazon-science/attune and OpenRecipes, a leaderboard of tuned and verified training recipes, at https://openrecipes.ai.

deep_reading.title: ATTUNE: Agentic Throughput Tuning for LLM Training
deep_reading.content:
LLM 训练吞吐取决于切分、显存-算力交换与通信重叠这套「配方」，换模型/加速器/框架就要重做。固定旋钮搜索只检查能跑，常漏掉空间外杠杆，还可能悄悄改训练语义。Amazon ATTUNE 是编码 agent：在 GPU-小时预算内无人值守改任意能跑配方。H100/H200/B200 上平均吞吐 +1.7×（最高约 3.9×），四条 NVIDIA AutoModel 官方基准配方被它高出 6–17%；留出模型上把写给别的场景的配方最高抬到 2.6×（MiniMax-M2）。==吞吐缺口往往在固定旋钮空间之外——让 coding agent 改配方，比在预设网格里搜更对症==。

## 1. 问题
现成自动调参在预设旋钮上贝叶斯/网格搜索，目标只是「跑得动」。真正缺口常在专家容量因子、重叠策略、内核选择等「配方文本」里。ATTUNE 把搜索改成改代码/配置的 agent 循环。

![ATTUNE 论文首页：agentic 吞吐调优问题陈述（PDF）。](figs/2610.17528/use1.png)

## 2. 方法
单 agent 做 reason–act：陈述假设 → 改一处 → 跑 profile → 诊断瓶颈。agent 外的确定性门控拒绝会改训练目标的旗标、判定测量是否有效、是否超过当前 leader；搜索结束后再做一致性检查。预算按 GPU-小时封顶，无人值守。

![方法页：reason–act 循环与确定性门控（PDF）。](figs/2610.17528/use2.png)

## 3. 核心贡献
把「调参」升级成「改配方」：搜索空间不再被旋钮表绑死，同时用门控防止 silent training change。==可改的是配方文本，不可改的是训练语义——门控把两者拆开==。

## 4. 实验
在多代 NVIDIA 集群上替换生产/基准配方：平均 +1.7×，峰值约 3.9×；对 NVIDIA AutoModel 已发布吞吐高 6–17%。留出模型（开发未见）上，跨场景配方迁移最高 +2.6×；vendor 已精细调过的面提升最小。同 GPU-小时预算下优于含贝叶斯优化在内的自动调参基线。

| 设置 | 观察 |
| --- | --- |
| H100/H200/B200 平均 | 吞吐 +1.7× |
| 峰值 | 约 +3.9× |
| vs AutoModel 发布配方 | +6–17% |
| 留出 MiniMax-M2 | 最高 +2.6× |

![结果页：吞吐提升（PDF）。](figs/2610.17528/use3.png)


示意走查：一份 MoE 配方在 H100 上卡住通信。agent 假设 expert capacity 过大导致 token 路由不均，改一处 capacity 因子后重跑 profile；门控确认 loss 曲线未偏、吞吐上升则接纳。下一轮再动 overlap。整段搜索耗尽预算后输出最终配方与拒绝日志。

与「只搜并行度/微批」的自动调参相比，ATTUNE 能改到框架脚本里的非旋钮杠杆；代价是必须有强门控，否则 agent 可能打开会改数值结果的旗标。作者在多代集群与留出模型上验证：收益最大的往往是「别人写的配方迁到你的堆栈」，而不是在已 vendor 精调的面上再抠几个点。

## 5. 局限
依赖可跑的初始配方与可解析的 profile；门控规则需随框架版本维护；吞吐收益不等于收敛曲线不变，需回归 loss。

## 6. 实践意义
训练平台可把 ATTUNE 类 agent 挂在「新模型×新集群」接入流程；先跑门控白名单，再放 GPU-小时预算。

papers.title: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
papers.abstract: Data-intensive GPU applications increasingly rely on NVMe SSDs to extend GPU memory. NVIDIA GPU Direct Storage (GDS) enables direct SSD-GPU transfers via PCIe peer-to-peer DMA, eliminating host staging. However, GDS retains three key limitations: (1) its control path traverses the kernel for every I/O request, introducing software overhead; (2) its stream-ordered path imposes strict total ordering even when workloads only require batch-level ordering; and (3) its closed-source user-space engine hinders diagnosis and custom scheduling. We present uGDS, https://github.com/ScaleX-IO/uGDS, an open-source user-space GPU Direct Storage library built on four principles: user-space control, unified cross-vendor abstraction, workload-aware scheduling, and end-to-end transparency. The host CPU manages the entire NVMe command lifecycle in user space, while payloads move via PCIe P2P DMA without consuming GPU compute. A minimal kernel module (ugds_drv.ko) is used only for one-time privileged setup. uGDS partitions hardware queues between synchronous and batch traffic, enforces DMA-safe buffer lifetimes, and provides cuFile-compatible synchronous, batched, and stream-ordered APIs with polling or interrupt completion on both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP. Evaluated on an A100 with a Samsung 990 PRO, uGDS achieves up to 12.12x GDS's batch-read bandwidth and 30.69x its batch-write bandwidth (8- and 4-KiB requests, batch size 128), and reduces 4-KiB synchronous write latency by 84.1% with two threads. Its stream-ordered path sustains 5.49 GiB/s on a single stream, where GDS retains only 40.8% of its synchronous bandwidth. In LMCache, uGDS reduces median time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 62.7% and raises serving goodput by 2.63x. On AMD, uGDS achieves up to 1.19x hipFile's synchronous-write bandwidth.
papers.authors: Jing Wei, Guanyi Chen, Qi Chen, Chuyu Zhang, Zheng Zhou, Chutian Wang, Jian Zhang

papers.summary: NVIDIA GDS 让 NVMe 经 PCIe P2P 直达 GPU，但仍有三条硬伤：控制面每次 I/O 穿内核、stream 路径强全序、用户态引擎闭源难诊。uGDS 做成用户态开发套件；在 Samsung 990 PRO 上批量读带宽最高达 GDS 的 12.12×、写 30.69×，两线程下 4-KiB 同步写延迟降 84.1%。GDS 单 stream 只保住同步 16-MiB 读带宽的 40.8%，提交调用可占墙钟 99.6%。==GPU Direct Storage 的瓶颈常在控制面与排序语义，而不只在 DMA 带宽==。

deep_reading.title: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
deep_reading.content:
NVIDIA GDS 让 NVMe 经 PCIe P2P 直达 GPU，但仍有三条硬伤：控制面每次 I/O 穿内核、stream 路径强全序、用户态引擎闭源难诊。uGDS 做成用户态开发套件（libugds + 最小内核辅助）。Samsung 990 PRO 上批量读带宽最高达 GDS 的 12.12×、写 30.69×；两线程下 4-KiB 同步写延迟 −84.1%。单 stream 上 GDS 只保住同步 16-MiB 读带宽的 40.8%，提交调用可占墙钟 99.6%。接入 LMCache 后 TTFT 中位数最高 −62.7%，serving goodput 2.63×。==GPU Direct Storage 的瓶颈常在控制面与排序语义，而不只在 DMA 带宽==。

## 1. 问题
KV cache offload 等小 I/O 对固定每请求内核开销极敏感；GDS stream API 的全序在只需批级序时过强；闭源引擎阻碍定制调度。

![uGDS 首页（PDF）。](figs/2610.30868/use1.png)

## 2. 方法
三路径：Setup 用特权内核委托建好队列后稳态绕开 OS；Control 在用户态发 NVMe；Data 走自主 P2P DMA。硬件队列拆成延迟敏感同步请求与深批队列。提供可诊断的用户态调度钩子。

![架构页（PDF）。](figs/2610.30868/use2.png)

## 3. 核心贡献
把 GDS 的控制面搬出内核热路径，并把排序语义从「全序 stream」降到批级需求。==省的是提交开销与错误排序，不是再抠 PCIe 峰值==。

## 4. 实验
| 指标 | uGDS vs GDS |
| --- | --- |
| 批读带宽 | 最高 12.12× |
| 批写带宽 | 最高 30.69× |
| 4-KiB 同步写延迟（2 线程） | −84.1% |
| 单 stream 相对同步带宽 | GDS 仅保留 40.8% |
| LMCache TTFT 中位 | 最高 −62.7% |
| LMCache goodput | 2.63× |
| AMD vs hipFile 同步写 | 最高 1.19× |

![结果页（PDF）。](figs/2610.30868/use3.png)


示意走查：LMCache 把 KV 块写入 SSD。GDS 路径上每次 4-KiB 写都进内核提交，墙钟几乎耗在提交而非 DMA；换成 uGDS 后同步写走用户态队列，TTFT 中位数下降。批读场景下把请求聚到深批队列，带宽接近器件上限。

作者对比还覆盖 AMD hipFile：同一套用户态思路在非 NVIDIA 栈上仍有同步写带宽收益（最高约 1.19×），说明问题不单是某一家闭源引擎，而是「控制面是否在热路径」。对诊断，开源用户态让人能看清队列深度与顺序，而不是只拿到一个黑盒带宽数字。

## 5. 局限
依赖特定 NVMe/GPU/PCIe 拓扑；用户态轮询占 SM 的权衡需按负载调；安全模型与多租户隔离要额外工程。

## 6. 实践意义
KV offload / 训练 ZeRO-offload 路径可优先测 uGDS 类用户态直存；先看小 I/O 延迟与提交占比，再谈带宽。

papers.title: RACE: RoPE-Aligned Attention Compression Based on Query-Key Activation Energies
papers.abstract: Head-dimension compression can reduce the memory required by the key-value (KV) cache, but existing methods often reconstruct full-dimensional representations during inference, adding significant decoding FLOPs overhead. We formalize the design considerations for converting pretrained attention into a natively reduced-dimensional form that reduces both KV-cache storage and attention computation using a calibration set. Specifically, we consider reductions that (1) apply a shared projection to queries and keys so that they remain in a common reduced feature space, (2) derive this projection jointly from query and key activations to better preserve their interaction, and (3) are compatible with the pretrained RoPE transformation. To obtain a reconstruction-free realization of this reduction, we restrict it to coordinate selection and theoretically show that RoPE compatibility then holds if and only if complete rotary pairs are retained. Building on this characterization, we introduce RACE, a post-training method that selects rotary pairs using their joint query-key activation energy. We theoretically show that this criterion minimizes a separable, calibration-dependent upper bound on post-RoPE query-key product approximation error. The resulting reductions are folded into the model weights and require neither runtime reconstruction nor specialized kernels. Across three model families and different compression levels, RACE outperforms structured pruning and remains competitive with reconstruction-based methods on language-modeling, zero-shot, and long-context tasks. At 50% KV-cache retention and 256K context, RACE reduces total inference FLOPs by 47.8%, yielding 1.79x higher throughput, 43.2% lower time-to-first-token (TTFT), and 28.1% lower allocated GPU memory in comparison to an uncompressed model.
papers.authors: Irene Tenison, Abdulrahman Alabdulkareem, Daniel Karl I. Weidele, Nima Dehmamy, Dan Gutfreund
papers.scoring_provenance: Existing per-paper assessment reviewed against rerun candidate title and abstract
papers.summary: 压 KV cache 的头维常在推理时再还原全维，解码 FLOPs 反而涨。RACE 用校准集把预训练注意力改成原生降维形式：对 Q/K 共享投影、保留 RoPE 对齐，并按 query-key 激活能量压缩，存储与注意力算力一起降。50% KV 保留、256K 上下文时，总推理 FLOPs −47.8%，吞吐 1.79×，TTFT −43.2%，解码延迟 −28.1%。==头维压缩要「原生降维」而不是推理时再拼回全维，否则省下的显存会换成解码算力税==。

deep_reading.title: RACE: RoPE-Aligned Attention Compression Based on Query-Key Activation Energies
deep_reading.content:
头维压缩 KV cache 常在推理时再还原全维，解码 FLOPs 反而涨。RACE 用校准集把预训练注意力改成原生降维：对 Q/K 共享投影并保持 RoPE 对齐，按 query-key 激活能量决定保留哪些能量方向，使 KV 存储与注意力算力一起降。50% KV 保留、256K 上下文时，总推理 FLOPs −47.8%，吞吐 1.79×，TTFT −43.2%，分配显存 −28.1%。相对 EigenAttention / PALU / Thin Keys / RAP，RACE 在「保留 RoPE、共享投影、降存储、降注意力 FLOPs、免推理还原」清单上全部勾选。==头维压缩要原生降维，而不是推理时再拼回全维==。

## 1. 问题
KV 变长拖垮显存与带宽；只压 token 或量化不够时，有人压头维。若解码期重建全维 K/V，省下的显存会换成 FLOPs 税。需要校准期一次性改成降维注意力。

![全维 vs 压缩注意力（论文图）。](figs/2610.28385/use1.png)

## 2. 方法
共享投影把 Q/K 映到同一低维空间，旋转位置编码在低维上仍对齐；用激活能量选主方向，V 同步压缩。校准集约一次；推理不再上投影回全维。可与 token 减少、量化叠加（文中有组合实验）。

## 3. 核心贡献
把「压缩」从缓存格式问题提升为注意力算子本身的降维，且不破坏 RoPE 几何。==省显存的同一套投影也应省注意力算力==。

## 4. 实验
Llama/Qwen 系列在零样本、困惑度、LongBench 上对比。50% 保留 + 256K：FLOPs −47.8%，吞吐 1.79×，TTFT −43.2%，显存 −28.1%。对照表显示竞品常在「推理重建」或「不保 RoPE」上留缺口。

| 设置 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| KV 保留 | 50% |
| 上下文 | 256K |
| 总推理 FLOPs | −47.8% |
| 吞吐 | 1.79× |
| TTFT | −43.2% |
| GPU 显存 | −28.1% |

![精度曲线。](figs/2610.28385/use2.png)
![FLOPs/吞吐。](figs/2610.28385/use3.png)

## 5. 局限
校准集域偏移会影响能量方向；与激进量化叠用时要重扫保留比例；超长上下文的端到端速度还受别的算子影响。

## 6. 实践意义
服务侧若 KV 显存紧，优先试「原生降维注意力」而非「压完再还原」；保留 50% 作为默认扫描点，看 TTFT 与 LongBench 是否可接受。

papers.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
papers.authors: Tianyu Fu, Ruoxi Wang, Zihan Min, Zhongqi Ren, Zhihao Li, Tengxuan Liu, Shengxu Mu, Hanling Zhang, Yu Wang

papers.summary: Agent 长轨迹里 KV cache 读写与存储成主成本，改前缀还会让后续 cache 失效、被迫重 prefill。本文把「缓存工程」从改历史文本，转向管 cache 生命周期与驱逐策略；相对常规阈值触发摘要，简单工具响应 drop 策略平均成本 −27.7%、基准分 +1.7，配合 AKV 可达约 1.2× 输出吞吐与 1.5× P95 延迟改善；RSI 策略在留出任务上再降成本 7.1%。API 账单里 KV 读可占 82.4%。==Agent 省钱的关键常是「别让 cache 失效」，而不只是把历史摘要得更短==。

deep_reading.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
deep_reading.content:
Agent 长轨迹里 KV 读写与存储成主成本；改历史前缀会让后续 cache 失效并重 prefill。本文提出缓存工程：agent 用 drop 排除选中 cache、用 repos 调整保留 key 的位置索引，从而直接控制活跃 KV，而不改写轨迹文本。相对阈值触发摘要，简单工具响应 drop 策略平均成本 −27.7%、基准分 +1.7；接 AKV 后输出吞吐约 1.2×、P95 延迟约 1.5× 改善；RSI 自改进策略在留出任务再降成本 7.1%。API 账单里 KV 读可占 82.4%。==Agent 省钱的关键常是别让 cache 失效，而不只是把历史摘要得更短==。

## 1. 问题
上下文工程靠修剪/摘要减长度，但改前缀使后缀 KV 作废。账单显示 KV 读可占八成以上费用。需要「动 cache、不动文本」的控制面。

![上下文工程 vs 缓存工程（PDF）。](figs/2610.28577/use1.png)

## 2. 方法
暴露 drop / repos 原语：drop 让后续注意力看不到选中段；repos 在不改内容的前提下改位置编码索引。策略可手写（如丢工具回包），也可用递归自改进（RSI）在留出任务上搜策略。

![设定页（PDF）。](figs/2610.28577/use2.png)

## 3. 核心贡献
把优化对象从「提示词字符串」换成「活跃 KV 集合」。==保留前缀字节不等于保留前缀 cache——失效一次就重付 prefill==。

## 4. 实验
三模型×四 agent 基准：工具响应 drop 相对阈值摘要，成本 −27.7%、分数 +1.7；AKV 上吞吐 ~1.18–1.2×、P95 ~1.5×；RSI +7.1% 成本再降。阈值摘要（如 48k）可降约 7% 成本但准确率掉约 5 个百分点，说明乱摘要会伤任务。

| 策略 | 成本 | 质量/系统 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工具响应 drop | −27.7% | 分 +1.7 |
| +AKV | — | 吞吐 ~1.2×，P95 ~1.5× |
| +RSI | 再 −7.1% | 留出任务 |

![注意力示意。](figs/2610.28577/use3.png)

## 5. 局限
依赖可写的 cache API（如 AKV）；drop 策略过猛会丢关键工具结果；RSI 搜索本身有费用。

## 6. 实践意义
Agent 运行时优先接「可 drop 的 KV 层」；默认先丢可重建的工具回包，再考虑摘要。

补充：正文数字均摘自论文表格与实验节；配图为论文 HTML/PDF 原图或页渲染，图注说明看点而非翻译英文 caption。

papers.title: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
papers.abstract: Large Language Model inference over long contexts is increasingly bottlenecked by the cost of attending to a growing Key-Value (KV) cache. Sparse attention reduces this cost by accessing only a fraction of the cache, but existing methods face a trade-off between deterministic retrieval, which captures high-scoring tokens but discards residual attention mass, and sampling, which improves coverage at the cost of higher variance. Hybrid methods combine top-$k$ retrieval with uniform sampling, yet still exhibit a substantial gap from dense attention at aggressive sparsity. We introduce \emph{Stratified Sparse Attention (SSA)}, a unified framework combining deterministic retrieval with score-guided sampling. SSA deterministically attends to high-scoring tokens while sampling the residual using proxy attention scores and correcting for their inclusion probabilities, thereby recovering attention mass beyond the retrieval set. SSA encompasses top-$k$, top-$p$, and hybrid top-$k$+sampling as special cases. Across RULER, LongBench, LOFT, and AIME, and five models ranging from 3B to 27B parameters, SSA consistently improves over the baselines at matched sparsity. On RULER-HARD with Ministral-3-8B, SSA improves accuracy over the strongest practical baseline from 81.8\% to 84.2\% at 32K and from 63.8\% to 69.3\% at 128K under $50\times$ attention sparsity, recovering 94\% and 85\% of dense-attention performance, respectively. With optimized CUDA kernels, SSA achieves up to $2.96\times$ decode speedup over FlashInfer at 1M context, demonstrating that its accuracy gains translate into practical long-context inference acceleration. We open-source our code at https://github.com/skylight-org/SSA-Paper-Code.
papers.authors: Sahil Joshi, Prithvi Dixit, Aryan Katiyar, Agniva Chowdhury, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Anshumali Shrivastava, Aditya Desai, Kumar Krishna Agrawal

papers.summary: 长上下文推理被不断增长的 KV 注意力拖住；稀疏注意力用确定性 top-k 会丢掉残余注意力质量，用采样又方差大，混合仍与稠密有明显差距。Stratified Sparse Attention（SSA）按层分层分配稀疏预算，缩小极端稀疏下的稀疏-稠密鸿沟：50× 稀疏时，相对最强实用基线，32K 从 81.8%→84.2%、128K 从 63.8%→69.3%，分别收回稠密性能的 94% 与 85%；百万上下文解码相对 FlashInfer 最高 2.96×。==极端稀疏下要分层补残余注意力质量，而不是只抠 top-k==。

deep_reading.title: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
deep_reading.content:
长上下文解码被增长的 KV 注意力拖住。稀疏注意力用确定性 top-k 会丢掉残余注意力质量，用采样又方差大，混合仍与稠密有差距。Stratified Sparse Attention（SSA）按层把稀疏预算分给确定性利用与随机探索，缩小极端稀疏下的稀疏-稠密鸿沟。50× 稀疏时，相对最强实用基线，RULER 等上 32K 从 81.8%→84.2%、128K 从 63.8%→69.3%，分别收回稠密性能的 94% 与 85%；百万上下文解码相对 FlashInfer 最高 2.96×。==极端稀疏下要分层补残余注意力质量，而不是只抠 top-k==。

## 1. 问题
只取 top-k 丢残余质量；纯采样方差大；top-k+均匀采样仍有稠密缺口。需要在固定预算 k 下更好分配「必定取」与「随机探」。

![SSA 算法图。](figs/2610.28441/use1.png)

## 2. 方法
三阶段：用代理分数把预算在 token 上分成确定段与采样段；对采样段按分层/概率抽取以覆盖残余质量；用定制 CUDA 核减少内存流量。均匀采样与纯 top-k 是特例。

![预算划分。](figs/2610.28441/use2.png)

## 3. 核心贡献
在极端稀疏比下系统性地缩小 sparse–dense gap，而不是只报加速比。==加速只有在质量贴住稠密时才算数==。

## 4. 实验
RULER / LongBench / LOFT / AIME，模型 3B–更大。50× 稀疏：32K 81.8→84.2，128K 63.8→69.3（收复 94%/85% 稠密）。H200 上 1M 上下文解码注意力层相对 FlashInfer 最高 2.96×；分片数 64 vs 32 约 1.58–1.71×。

| 上下文 | 基线 | SSA | 相对稠密 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 32K @50× | 81.8% | 84.2% | ~94% |
| 128K @50× | 63.8% | 69.3% | ~85% |

![加速。](figs/2610.28441/use3.png)

## 5. 局限
代理分数质量影响分层；极端 batch 下速度优势变化；与其它稀疏核集成需工程。

## 6. 实践意义
长上下文服务若已上稀疏注意力，用 SSA 式预算分层做 A/B，先看 50× 稀疏下 RULER/长基准相对稠密的回收率。

补充：正文数字均摘自论文表格与实验节；配图为论文 HTML/PDF 原图或页渲染，图注说明看点而非翻译英文 caption。

papers.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 2
papers.abstract: The Global Performance Tuner is a feature for automatic performance tuning released in NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1. It provides automatic, accuracy-aware and end-to-end performance tuning within TensorRT by customizing different optimizations for different models. This post, Part 2, uses the notation from Part 1 to describe the algorithm and architectural design of the Global Performance Tuner feature. It also provides best practices for using it.

papers.title: When PTQ Calibration Helps or Hurts: Dose-Driven Collapse and Validation-Gated Abstention in Quantized Text Embedders
papers.authors: Hyojung Han, Ryangkyung Kang, Youngeun Kim, Seung-Hun Jeon
papers.abstract: Learned post-training quantization (PTQ) calibration fits quantizer parameters on a small calibration set, and for a text embedder the natural supervision is retrieval relevance. We ask two questions that are usually conflated: how far to calibrate, and whether to calibrate at all. Across three embedders (e5-base-v2, BGE-M3, EmbeddingGemma-300m) at 4-bit weight quantization, 161 calibration runs, the outcome of a fixed procedure ranges from a gain to catastrophic degradation, and the driver is the dose of the update, measured as the functional displacement D_func of the quantized model from its uncalibrated start. On EmbeddingGemma the same learning-rate grid gives +1.47 to -71.53 points of in-domain NDCG@10 change; a label-free cosine objective collapses at the same dose (-69.52 vs -71.63), so the collapse is a property of learnable calibration rather than of retrieval supervision. Objective sensitivity is heterogeneous: on e5, ranking calibration is substantially more robust than cos

papers.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

papers.title: Lychee: Certified Screening of Inverted Lists for High-Recall Vector Search
papers.abstract: Nearest-neighbor search over embedding vectors matches faces against watchlists, transactions against known fraud patterns, and medical images against confirmed cases, where a missed neighbor is a missed threat, fraud, or diagnosis. Because an approximate index cannot report which queries lost a true neighbor, these applications require recall of 0.999 to 0.9999, at a cost far below that of exact search over billions of vectors. Inverted-file indexes reach high recall by probing more lists, but they read and score every probed vector at full precision, so that throughput falls in inverse proportion to the number of probed lists. Graph indexes saturate below these targets, whereas quantized lists must rerank their candidates with the full vectors. Our insight is to decide for almost every probed vector that it cannot enter the top k of the probed lists without reading the vector, through the certified lower bound of exact search by certified exclusion. This paper turns this insight into Lychee, a GPU inverted-file search that screens the probed lists on tensor cores under a threshold from anchors of the same lists and computes exact distances only for the few survivors. We prove that Lychee returns exactly the k nearest vectors of the probed lists, the answer of an inverted-file search at full precision, while it reads a few hundred full vectors per query regardless of the number of probed lists. On eleven datasets from one million to one billion vectors and against ten GPU and CPU baselines, Lychee is 9.7 to 117 times faster than IVF-Flat at equal recall with 200 probed lists on datasets of up to 100 million vectors. It also reaches recall levels that CAGRA and HNSW do not reach and outruns exact search by certified exclusion by 5 to 18 times above ten million vectors. On four GPUs, Lychee searches one billion vectors at recall 0.9999, 44.5 times faster than IVF-Flat on BIGANN-1B.

papers.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 1
papers.abstract: Deploying a trained neural network involves more than translating each operator into a GPU kernel. It is a compilation problem with many legitimate answers. For example, when NVIDIA TensorRT builds an engine, it makes interdependent decisions about graph-IR transformations, fusion, implementation selection, memory placement, and quantization. This process is called scheduling.
